description: Step 2 of voting. Confirms the vote with the 6-digit code the user read from their email. The vote counts at this moment. Returns a voter_pass (valid 7 days) so the user can vote in the other awards with awards_vote and check their votes with awards_my_votes without a new code. Never guess a code: only pass what the user typed.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the email, as the user typed it.

name: awards_vote_confirm

message.description: One or two sentences to show the user as they are.

title: Confirm a vote with the code
